title: Depth-three circuit reduction with error at most $\varepsilon$
statement:
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ with $n\ge 1$, and suppose $f$ is the conjunction of $s_2$ DNF formulas $D_1,\dots,D_{s_2}$, so that $f(x)=1$ exactly when $D_i(x)=1$ for every index $i$; equivalently, $f$ is computed by a depth-three AND-of-OR-of-AND circuit. Assume each formula $D_i$ has width at most $w$ with $w\ge 1$, and that within every term no literal is repeated and no variable occurs in two opposite polarities, so that a term reads each variable at most once. Fix integers $l\ge 1$ and $t\ge 0$ and a real number $\varepsilon$ satisfying $s_2\,(1/2)^{l}\le \varepsilon/2$ and $(1/2)^{t}\le\varepsilon/2$, and put $p_1=1/(40w)$ and $p_2=1/(40l)$. Draw a Bernoulli random restriction $\rho$ with parameter $p_1 p_2$, and write $f_\rho$ for the restriction of $f$ by $\rho$. Then the probability that the decision-tree depth of $f_\rho$ exceeds $t$ is at most
\[
\varepsilon+s_2\,e^{-np_1/3}+e^{-np_2/3}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is the conjunction of s_2 DNF gates (f(x)=1 iff every gate evaluates true)
each gate has width at most w
within each term, literals sharing a variable are equal (no variable in both polarities)
each term has no duplicated literal
caveat: The conclusion of the Lean statement is elided in the snippet: its body reads `let p₁ : ℝ := sorry`, so the probability bound above could not be checked against the formal ground truth. All hypotheses are rendered faithfully from the Lean, but the displayed conclusion — the event, the composed Bernoulli restriction with parameter $p_1 p_2 = (1/(40w))(1/(40l))$, and the exponential tail terms — is reconstructed from the existing informal statement together with the supplied definitions (composed restriction parameter, decision-tree depth, restricted function, Bernoulli event probability). It should be re-verified once the actual conclusion is available.
replaced:
For a depth-3 circuit in normal form, if $l$ and $t$ are chosen so that
$s_2 (1/2)^l \le \varepsilon/2$ and $(1/2)^t \le \varepsilon/2$, then under the
composed Bernoulli$(\mathrm{composedDelta}\,w\,l\,3)$ restriction (with $p_1 = 1/(40w)$,
$p_2 = 1/(40l)$),
\[
\Pr_\rho[\mathrm{dtDepth}(\mathrm{restrictFn}\, f\,\rho) > t]
\le \varepsilon + s_2\exp(-np_1/3) + \exp(-np_2/3).
\]
The exponential tails vanish as $n \to \infty$, so the bound is $\le \varepsilon$
asymptotically.
